'''Operation Cloudfall''' was an operation that was enacted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] in [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]], to strip the world of all its [[madilon]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. Initially, the project ran on schedule, and the Empire was able to increase its production of madilon. However, some of the native [[Nyriaanan]] clans protested about the way in which their planet was being exploited, so the Empire had them [[Death/Legends|killed]] or [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. The project eventually brought ecological disaster to a quarter of Nyriaan's land mass, and was ended in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], as a result of the actions of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]-sponsored insurgency.
